In 1627 to 1629 imperial armies under Tilly and Wallenstein occupied the Jutland peninsula from the Elbe to Skagen. In 1643 to 1645 a Swedish army under Torstensson occupied the same ground by the same route. In neither war were Zealand, Funen or Scania touched, because the Danish fleet held the water.">
